iWant: to set Squire up on my Mac from one download, one step at a time, without ever opening Terminal
soThat: I can install and start using my own assistant without technical help
description: The installer journey: the Mac check, one yes for what will be installed, Apple's developer tools, Claude Code, the Claude sign-in, naming the Squire, the folders, the always-on session, the phone, the Keychain, the browser, the nightly backup, wake-ups, voice notes, the health check and the guided first conversation. The installer also sets Claude Code's auto-compact window. The eligibility refusal (a Mac below macOS 13, or a Claude plan below Pro) is part of this journey and is defined at this journey's round.
title: Set-up: from the download to a first reply, with no Terminal

acceptanceCriteria.description: Setting Squire up never needs Terminal.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A fresh macOS user on a Mac that meets Squire's requirements
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire is set up from the download to the end of set-up
acceptanceCriteria.then: Set-up completes with no Terminal window opened by or for the Squire owner.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The installer sets Claude Code's auto-compact window to 500k tokens, and the health check reports any drift from it.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A fresh Claude Code configuration, and configurations that set the auto-compact window otherwise: at the top level of the settings, per model, in the environment and on the command line
acceptanceCriteria.when: The installer runs and Squire's session starts, and a setting later changes the window
acceptanceCriteria.then: The session's effective auto-compact window is 500k tokens after the installer runs, and the health check reports the drift when a setting changes it.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Setting Squire up and using it for the first time work end to end on a fresh Mac.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A fresh macOS user on a Mac that meets Squire's requirements, with a Claude Pro plan or above
acceptanceCriteria.when: The Squire owner runs the installer from the download and opens their Squire
acceptanceCriteria.then: Every step passes without Terminal, and the Squire owner gets a first reply from their Squire.
